sentences.text: None appears for the petitioner when the matter is called on for hearing.

On 10th July, 2019 and 11th July, 2019 also none appeared for the petitioner when the matter was called on for hearing nor any accommodation was prayed for and as such in order to give one more chance hearing was adjourned for the day.

The instant revision has been preferred against the judgment and order dated June 28, 2004 passed by the learned Sessions Judge, 3rd Fast Track Court, Calcutta in Criminal Appeal No.42 of 2003 thereby dismissing the appeal and affirming the conviction and sentence passed by the learned Municipal Magistrate, 3rd Court, Calcutta in Case No.11-D of 1996 under Section 16(1) (a) (I) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

entities.text: Sessions Judge, 3rd Fast Track Court, Calcutta

sentences.text: Department is directed to issue Administrative Notice to the parties.
Let the matter appear in the monthly combined list of August, 2019.
